verdicts.reason: Both are unusable. Each puts the forest art in a narrow strip in the middle of a mostly white banner. The headline, subhead, quote and URL are gone, and the only visible text is a tiny, low-contrast 'March 21' in pale yellow on white plus faint stray rules at the left. A also shows a cut-off fragment 'Joint' over the art, which shows the copy was truncated. B shows no copy at all on the art. Neither keeps the message or the hierarchy, and neither fits the banner format.
